method: Built-in image generation using existing player portraits as identity references

avatars.prompt: A friend catches him laughing while seated on the living room floor beside a sofa, holding a game controller low at his lap. Dark casual tee, head and upper torso visible, informal slightly high camera angle. Large private house lounge, no public buildings.

Candid breakfast photo in the private gaming house kitchen. Grey sweatshirt, sitting at the island looking sideways at a friend and trying not to laugh, cereal bowl below frame. Head and shoulders, normal indoor morning light, no academic buildings.

Relaxed candid photo slouched comfortably on a house sofa in a dark hoodie, talking with someone off camera. Slight side angle, head and shoulders centered, a lamp and residential curtain behind. Not a hallway, office, or classroom.

A slightly grainy evening photo taken by a friend at his home gaming desk. Plain navy tee, headset around neck, turning toward the friend with a small grin, head and shoulders. Soft monitor light plus ordinary desk lamp, private residential bedroom, not a university.

Candid photo beside a digital piano in a house music room, dark blue sweatshirt, looking down and smiling after playing a wrong note. Head and shoulders, residential rug and curtain behind, normal daylight. No school corridor or institutional architecture.

A friend photographs him leaning against the gaming house kitchen counter in a cream tee, laughing mid-conversation. Head and shoulders, wooden cabinets and simple residential cooker behind, not a dining hall or cafe. Hands out of frame.
